content.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
content.abstract: We address the question: “What does a prediction-market contract reveal at launch about its future?” Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket, a leading prediction market, between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market’s title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed.
